reason: A browser-only UI plugin that adds a right-edge navigation rail for jumping among user messages, previewing them, loading earlier history, and pinning assistant replies.

summaries.zh: 在对话页面右侧添加节点导航条，用于预览、跳转和固定消息，并支持加载更早的历史记录。
summaries.en: Adds a right-edge conversation navigation rail for previewing, jumping between, and pinning messages, with support for loading earlier history.

capabilities: Provides hover previews and click-to-jump navigation
Forwards requests to load earlier conversation history
Stores pinned message state in browser localStorage per session
